question: To whom may this Kaula teaching be given and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy.
It should not be given to just anyone.
The instruction sets a restriction on transmission.
inference: This Kaula teaching must be transmitted only to the worthy and withheld from others.
plain_english: This Kaula teaching should be given to the worthy, not to just anyone.
